description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Selvala.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Havengul Lich triggers, giving it Selvala's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Havengul Lich using Selvala's ability by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Soliton.
Cast Soliton by paying its mana cost.
Havengul Lich triggers, giving it Soliton's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Havengul Lich using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping Havengul Lich.
Activate Havengul Lich using Selvala's ability by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Repeat from step 8.
